# pangolin_user (Data Source)

Look up an existing org user by org_id and either user_id or username. Exactly one of user_id or username must be set.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pangolin_user" "example" {
  org_id   = "acme"
  username = "jane"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `org_id` (String)

### Optional

- `user_id` (String)
- `username` (String)
